goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T007 proves the bounded generation protocol, but generated runs are not promoted into a destination project's current ref, the viewer does not consume production receipts or renders, and release signing is only package-level CI metadata. Approve one cohesive local release-handoff slice: reversible promotion, normalized unavailable adapter states, viewer evidence display, and optional locally verifiable signing. Keep Meshy, All2API, Unity, and external visual QA unavailable unless independently configured.

worker_package.objective: Implement one local production-release handoff: promote a verified generated run into a destination Project current ref with immutable artifact copies and reversible checkpointing; persist run receipt, six renders, provenance, QA, promotion, adapter availability, and release metadata; expose promotion/release verification through CLI, HTTP, and typed MCP; and update the desktop viewer to show the receipt, six renders, adapter states, release proof, and truthful promotion state.
verify: run_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; project_dir="$(mktemp -d)/project"; python3 -m open3d_artist production-run --brief examples/production-qualification/brief.json --output "$run_dir"; python3 -m open3d_artist production-promote --run "$run_dir" --project "$project_dir"; python3 -m open3d_artist validate "$project_dir"
stop_if: Any required change falls outside allowed_files.
Promotion can replace current state without preserving a checkpoint or can claim APPROVED without external visual-QA and Unity evidence.
Run artifacts, render paths, or release manifests are accepted without digest and path validation.
Provider, reference, visual-QA, Unity, or signing states are fabricated, or secrets are persisted or exposed to the viewer/MCP.
CLI, HTTP, and MCP promotion/release receipts diverge materially or permit arbitrary commands or unrestricted filesystem reads.
The viewer cannot load the receipt, all six named renders, promotion state, and release proof.
Verification fails twice without a clear local fix.

deferred_work: Real Meshy/All2API calls, remote reference generation, external visual QA, bounded repair, and Unity approval.
Expansion beyond the representative fixture and native desktop packaging/browser automation.
Public artifact publication and GitHub OIDC attestations for production runs; local HMAC proof remains optional and is not approval.
Multi-run migration, garbage collection, and concurrency hardening.
missing_evidence: No promotion operation writes a destination project's current ref.
No reversible promotion receipt or release manifest exists.
No normalized provider/reference/visual-QA availability record exists in the agent receipt.
The viewer does not fetch production state or display six renders.
No local signature generation and verification exists for run release metadata.

parallel_safety.reason: This is one bounded write package with an explicit file scope; no concurrent Worker scope is proven.

required_board_updates: Copy worker_package verbatim to the next Worker task and activate it.
Keep T999 queued and the goal active; this package is not full-outcome completion.
